Mount rng is rolled once when it spawns to determine the species and again when caught to determine skill. you can save before it spawns to reroll the species, and save after it spawns to reroll the skill. tested with Ferghanan Horses in Sunfall Path (same set of world actions = consistently the same species/ability)

^ Adding that success of capture is determined once bait is placed from my testing. For example, if common bait placed and actions lead to correct species BUT fails to be captured. You can roll back to the save before bait was placed and upgrade the bait to a rarer bait or differnt bait and it can lead to succesful capture if repeating the same actions that spawned the specie. Even if it says bait is "perfect", you can still fail so try to save before bait is placed too just in case.
Also if correct species but wrong ability, waiting a turn or two+ can switch it to another ability if you can spare the turns (this was tested upon initial spawning; not sure if it is true when mount was spawned a long time before capturing)

^ mount RNG (both spawning and determining ability) draws from the same seed as overworld RNG, so different kinds of actions change the result, eg. placing bait then waiting 5 times might spawn something different than placing bait and doing search 1 time -> wait 4 times
